summary: This article explains how robots sense, think, and act, where they work today, and why they still depend on people.
introduce: Read the title “Robots Around Us” aloud and ask each student to write one question they hope the article will answer. Collect a few questions, then explain that today they will find the one big idea that ties all the details together.

keyTerms.def: done the same way again and again
exact and careful, with no mistakes
a doctor who does operations to fix problems inside the body

challengeTerms.def: the part of a machine, often a motor, that makes it move
a set of step-by-step instructions for solving a problem or doing a task
able to act or make decisions on its own, without someone controlling it

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that robots will one day do most of the jobs that people do today? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Robots are very good at some jobs but still need people.
struggling: Read the first part of the article aloud together, review repetitive, precise, and surgeon, and let weak readers complete a main-idea-and-details web with a partner.
gifted: Ask strong readers to read a challenging version and write a short paragraph that uses actuator, algorithm, and autonomous to state the main idea of the article in their own words.
